entries.reason: Rollback plan: the entire PR (ledger commits + pin commit bb1a463f) reverts with git revert of the set; no migration, no schema change, no dependency change. Stored-object safety: the only new stored object is .vibepro/reviews/<story>/surface-violations.json, which is additive-only, is read clean when absent, and whose corrupt/truncated states fail closed with a typed error, so a revert leaves no unreadable state behind. Version skew: an older vibepro binary running against a repo that already has a ledger file simply never reads it (the file is namespaced under .vibepro/reviews and old readers do not reference it), degrading to pre-ledger behavior without error; a newer binary against a repo without a ledger reads clean by design (AC-7). Feature gate: none exists and none is required - the gate blocks only on unacknowledged violations, and repos with no violations see a passed gate, so disabled-behavior testing has no subject. Upgrade/downgrade test: non-applicable for the same reason; the acceptance suite already covers the legacy-artifact leg (RSV-7 legacy lifecycles read clean). The npm-side rollback path for the version pin is owned by docs/specs/story-vibepro-release-0-2-0-beta-2.md Operations and unchanged here.
